name: YMCA Michigan Youth in Government
what_you_do: Join a school or YMCA delegation. You take part in a student-run model government. There are fall district conferences. There is a big Lansing conference in February or April.
who_can_apply: High school students (a separate middle school program exists). The pages do not list grades. You join through a school or YMCA delegation.
pay_detail: The base fee is not stated on the program page. A $25 late fee applies to late Lansing registration. A financial aid application is linked on the page.
duration: Fall district conference, then a Lansing conference of about four days
deadline_text: Fall district conferences run Oct 2 to Nov 9, 2026. Sign-up closes about two weeks before each one. District 6 (Detroit, Nov 9) closes Oct 26, 2026. Sign-up for the other fall districts has ended. Lansing sign-up opens Nov 10, 2026. February Lansing conference (Feb 18 to 21, 2027): regular sign-up closes Dec 27, 2026, late sign-up Dec 28 to Jan 13 with a $25 fee. April Lansing conference (Apr 22 to 25, 2027): regular sign-up closes Feb 28, 2027, late sign-up Mar 1 to 17 with a $25 fee.
how_to_apply: Check the map on the YMCA page to see if your school or YMCA has a delegation. If not, use the Contact us page to start one. Then register for the conferences your delegation attends.
notes: Not a job. The deadline date is the end of regular sign-up for the February Lansing conference. Lansing sign-up opens Nov 10, 2026. Fall conference sites include Marquette, Grayling, Allendale, Saginaw, Kalamazoo and Detroit. As of Oct 13, 2026, only the District 6 fall conference in Detroit is still open. The February and April Lansing windows are not open yet.
